resources.string: Puts Seelie\'s lock on your locked apps and vault apps wherever you open them from: recent apps, a notification or another app. Seelie only learns which app comes to the front, never what is on your screen or what you type.

Shows Seelie\'s own volume bar when you press the volume buttons. Seelie listens only to the two volume buttons and ignores every other key: it does not read your screen or what you type. With the screen off, during calls and while the phone rings, the phone\'s own volume stays.
